Unit: Sai Parenteral’s Limited   
 
Sub: Sub: Audio Recording of the Earnings call held on 2nd November, 2026 under Regulation

With reference to the subject cited, this is to inform the Exchanges that pursuant to Regulation 30 of

URL: https://www.saiparenterals.com/announcements/Earning_Call_Recording_02.11.2026.mp3

Thanking you.

For Sai Parenterals Limited
